headline: HuyenBao v11.57 — toast corner fix + free wellbeing bugfix + time x10/x50 + income-based loans
summary: MULTI-FIX. (1) Toast moved to top-right CORNER (was bottom-center, still overlapping gigs popup footer). Now compact + z-index 300 above modal — visible without covering centered modal content. (2) BUGFIX: free wellbeing actions (rest, self-train, meditate, rest7, rest30) were blocked when cash was negative because `wellReady` checked `s.money >= w.cost` even for cost=0 actions. Now free actions skip the money check — always available, even in debt. (3) Paid wellbeing cooldowns increased (gym 2→3, checkup 30→45, treat 5→8, temple 3→5, retreat 60→90 days). (4) Banking: loan limit now includes income-based credit — base = 50% of net worth + 30% of yearly income. A player with $30K NW + $30K income can now borrow $24K (was $15K). Credit breakdown shown in BankTab. (5) Time acceleration: x1 / x10 / x50 speed control in the header — fast-forward through calm periods (studying, waiting for a degree).
features: FIX: toast moved bottom-center → top-right CORNER (compact, z-index 300 above modal). No longer covers gigs popup content.
FIX: free wellbeing actions (rest/selftrain/meditate/rest7/rest30) now work when cash is negative — was blocked by `s.money >= w.cost` check even for cost=0
CHANGE: paid wellbeing cooldowns increased — gym 2→3d, checkup 30→45d, treat 5→8d, temple 3→5d, retreat 60→90d
NEW: banking loan limit includes income-based credit — base 50% NW + 30% yearly income
NEW: maxLoanOf(s) helper returns {total, base, incomeCredit, existing} for the BankTab breakdown
NEW: BankTab shows credit limit breakdown card (base + income credit − existing loan = available)
NEW: time acceleration control in header — x1 (▶) / x10 / x50. Multiplies elapsed real-time before passing to tick()
NEW: speedRef mirrors speed state so the game-loop useEffect reads current value without re-creating the interval
NEW: speed-ctrl CSS class — compact pill button group, accent color when active
NEW: i18n keys for speed.label, speed.tip, bank.creditBreakdown, bank.baseCredit, bank.incomeCredit, bank.existingLoan, bank.available, bank.incomeCreditNote, well.freeNote (EN/VI/中文)
